news_feeds.title: Sunday Compass — Quiet into Labor Day
news_feeds.body:
No major data Sunday. Markets continue digesting Friday’s strong US NFP (+162k) and soft Canada jobs (−42k).

USD supported; gold consolidating ~4440; BTC near 80k.

US markets closed Monday (Labor Day). Next key prints: PPI (10 Sep), CPI (11 Sep), FOMC (16-17 Sep).

news_feeds.title: US NFP August — Strong Beat +162k (recap)
news_feeds.body:
Nonfarm payrolls +162,000 (vs ~55k consensus). Unemployment rate steady at 4.1%. Wages +0.3% MoM / +3.1% YoY. Prior months revised higher.

Supports USD and keeps September Fed hike odds elevated.
